// diagnostic E0087

Jet.MarkerLibraryCasing

The library part of a qualified marker must be PascalCase.

What

The library part of a qualified marker must be PascalCase.

Why

Markers are PascalCase after `#`, including the library part, which spells the import's local name in PascalCase.

Fix

Write the library part in PascalCase, such as `#Server.Get` through `use server: core.http.server`; `jet fix` applies this edit.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.MarkerLibraryCasing: Tests/UI/QualifiedMarkerCoreAliasCasing/stderr.

Error: Jet.MarkerLibraryCasing: The library part of `#web_http.StaticRoutes` must be PascalCase
  --> Tests/UI/QualifiedMarkerCoreAliasCasing/main.jet:6:2
    |
  6 | #web_http.StaticRoutes
    |  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Markers are PascalCase after `#`, including the library part, which spells the import's local name in PascalCase
 Fix: Write `#WebHTTP.StaticRoutes`
